summary: A fresh currently authenticated assertion can acknowledge an exact existing worker evidence record without adding another. The nonce and match share the consequential FULL transaction; terminal outcomes, original packet/provenance/model identity and consumed execution authorization remain immutable. Retained completed-Task recovery uses original trusted host proof, refuses failed attempts, and keeps one caller deadline. Uncertain commits require reconciliation rather than a success or no-effect claim. Original record identifiers bound recovery; random-ID failure paths remain separate follow-up scope.
title: Exact worker-evidence acknowledgment appends no new evidence
